last.verdict: Sales growth beat forecasts by a wide margin, and investors looked past a bigger cost warning.

reasons.label: Sales growth doubled forecasts
reasons.text: Organic sales rose 4% versus roughly 2% expected, helped by 2% higher volume.

reasons.label: Profit beat estimates
reasons.text: Core EPS of $2.00 topped the $1.89 consensus; sales were $23.3B versus $22.8B expected.

reasons.label: Guidance held despite costs
reasons.text: Full-year profit outlook kept, though the commodity cost hit grew to about $1.4B from $1B.

story: After a flat-to-slow 2026, P&G's July report brought a sales miss, a muted 1-3% organic growth outlook and a stock drop. Earlier reports in January and April drew modest gains of roughly 2-3%. October's 4% growth reversed the slowdown narrative.
